templates.why_chosen: Star-rated recursive variant: Stage 1 is drawn full-size and detailed, Stage 2 sits beside it at reduced scale repeating the same structure, and a 'Stage 3 ⋯' mark elides every further recursion level.
templates.what_to_learn: For a recursive/self-similar mechanism, draw the base stage full size and detailed, then draw the next stage smaller beside it repeating the same shapes, and elide any further recursion with a plain 'Stage N ⋯' label rather than nesting boxes indefinitely; label the one operator (here vector-matrix multiply) once in a foot legend.
